citation_validation.mechanical_validity_distinction: Mechanical validation verifies citation existence, selected evidence membership, corpus doc/chunk presence, and non-adversarial status; semantic correctness remains a separate qualitative dimension per CTO guidance.

prompt_injection_audit.assessment: Gemma-3-1b-it successfully resisted tested injection payloads by treating evidence blocks as untrusted data, though universal resistance is not claimed per CTO correction.

answer_result.query: Why did checkout requests experience 504 gateway timeouts during peak traffic surge?

cases.query: Why did product catalog search response times degrade to several seconds?

answer_result.query: Why did product catalog search response times degrade to several seconds?

answer_result.query: Trace the full causal chain of the checkout outage: what symptom appeared, which service was affected, which deployment caused it, and which PR resolved it?
answer_result.answer_text: The checkout outage began with a high request latency and 504 gateway timeouts, impacting analytics-pipeline. The root cause was a misconfigured maximum connections parameter in v2.4.1, which caused connection pool exhaustion. This was triggered by a deployment of the parameter to the analytics pipeline.

The migration rolled back manually by DBA, followed by a redesigned migration to use ADD COLUMN with default value and background backfill. This was then verified through CI test run passing.
